scope: Five hundred microliters of 200 mM EPPS, 8M urea, pH 8.5 supplemented with 1X Pierce Protease Inhibitors was added directly to each 10 cm cell culture dish for on-dish lysis.

Cells were homogenized by 12 passes through a 21-gauge (1.25 inches long) needle. The homogenate was sedimented at 18,000 × g for 5 min. Protein concentrations were determined from the supernatant using the bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay.
